identity.summary: Computer Science and Artificial Intelligence student at IE University, building native applications, reusable simulation tools and robotics software. Research experience in AI and robotics, with projects spanning backend systems, computer vision and on-device AI.

experience.title: Research Assistant
bullets: Developed software for robotics research and demonstrations, collaborating with researchers on integration and troubleshooting.
Worked on MOSAIC, combining robot fleet coordination with calibrated floor visualization, recording and observation-only replay; movement authority remains in the robot application.

experience.title: Donation Automation Developer

Combined model-assisted extraction, caching and Selenium automation, reducing manual entry by 90% and saving an estimated 40 hours of administrative work per month.

certifications.title: AWS Educate Getting Started with Compute

noty: Developed a native macOS note application using Swift, SwiftUI and AppKit, with SQLite storage and notes attached to application windows.
Separated focus, window positioning and visibility, with recoverable editing and explicit privacy controls for optional AI access.
paddockjs: Built a reusable JavaScript/PixiJS racing simulator with composable browser views and a shared headless reset/step API.
Separated grid browsing from simulation state and exposed configurable rules and policy-evaluation interfaces. The package powers the project race on my portfolio.
whos-on-repeat: Designed and implemented a multiplayer music game as a solo course project, with a Python backend, SQLite transactions and server-timed scoring.
Separated room and game rules, protected answers until reveal, and integrated Spotify alongside an offline demo.
dream2detect: Designed and implemented the end-to-end pipeline for a group project: synthetic package images, human label review, model training and evaluation on real photographs.
The reported ensemble achieved 64.16% within one severity band on 385 real photos; exact-band accuracy was 21.04%.
vigil: Developed a robot-fleet operations dashboard using FastAPI, Paramiko and ROS interfaces, with browser-based SSH terminals.
Defined reusable diagnostic and recovery workflows, WebSocket terminal streaming and per-robot coordination to prevent conflicting jobs.
